name: getonbrd_com-mcp
description: Get on Board (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Public API ('No authentication required'): GET /api/v0/search/jobs with query, remote, page ('starting at 1') and per_page (maximum 120); expand=["company"] is sent so the company name is inline. country_code takes alpha-3 codes (example 'CHL') and there is no free-text place filter, so location and country are not sent. JSON:API hits: id is the job slug, attributes.description is HTML, attributes.published_at is a Unix epoch integer (raw), min/max_salary are integers with no documented currency, meta.total_pages is the only count (no total). Mirrors jobs/getonbrd (remote is not a deals input, so it is not sent); buyer is the expanded company name, min/max_salary map to budget_min/max.
